narr: Monsoon moisture remained over northern Arizona with dew points ranging from |50-65F, with precipitable water ranging from 1.50 to 0.75 - 0.92. Atmospheric instability was on the higher side as well. The highest CAPE values are expected along and south of the Mogollon Rim where values are forecast to range from 1000 J/kg to 1700 J/kg.
ev: Cienega Creek rose at least three feet.
A river guage (YAAA3) on Aqua Fria River (below Ash Creek) showed a rapid 3.5 foot rise beginning at 7:00 PM MST. The river returned to near normal levels at midnight.
lsr: Flood in Cienega Creek of a least 3 feet.
YAAA3 Gage (Aqua Fria below Ash Creek) observed a rapid 3.5 foot rise beginning at 7:52 PM MST.
